commit.message:
fix: SSRF bypass, hardcoded fallback defaults, and typos

- Parse URL to extract hostname before passing to is_ip_private(),
  add explicit localhost check (private-ip returns undefined for full
  URLs and the string "localhost", bypassing the SSRF guard entirely)
- Replace hardcoded `?? 5000` fallbacks with `?? downloadLimit` so the
  DEFAULT_LIMIT env var is respected
- Fix garbled "converted content to Markdown" description
- Remove stray `}` in template literal
